profile.name: Weiss SB 22 气候试验箱
profile.description: 用于控制和读取 Weiss SB 22 气候试验箱的温度、湿度及数字通道状态。该设备通过 RS-232 串口通信，适合环境模拟、样品老化与温湿度稳定性测试。
profile.description_en: Controls and reads temperature, humidity, and digital channel states of a Weiss SB 22 climate chamber. The device communicates via RS-232 serial interface and is used for environmental simulation, sample aging, and temperature/humidity stability testing.

registry.name: Weiss Technik Weiss SB 22 climate chamber
registry.description: Weiss Sb22是由Weiss Technik生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括写入数据、初始化、温度设置、温度读取、读取数据。支持Signal, Slot, check for errors等操作。
